approach: Incremental integration with R-divider regulator and capacitive startup
approach_rationale: Frontend draws ultra-low subthreshold current (~100pA-1nA). R-divider gives exactly 0.9V with <1% error under this load, needs no startup circuit, and is physically realizable (poly resistors + MIM cap). Capacitive kick startup for bias_gen avoids disturbing steady-state operation. Combined simulation validates all interface effects.

alternatives_considered.name: Active PMOS LDO regulator
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: Unnecessarily complex for ~1nA load. Adds error amplifier, reference, compensation cap. The frontend load is nearly constant, so regulation is not needed — just accurate voltage setting.

alternatives_considered.name: Cascaded diode-connected FET voltage drop
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: Voltage depends on current and temperature. At subthreshold currents, Vgs varies significantly with process. R-divider gives exact ratio regardless of current level.

alternatives_considered.name: Resistive startup for bias_gen (R from VDD to iref)
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: Even very large R (1GOhm) injects current comparable to or exceeding the 150pA mirror operating current, disturbing the bias point. Capacitive kick injects charge only during transient VDD ramp, zero DC disturbance.

steps.action: Design and test voltage regulator: R-divider (R1=R2=10MOhm) from VDD(1.8V) to VDD_frontend(0.9V) with 100pF bypass cap. Isolation test: apply 1.8V, verify 0.9V output, then connect bias_gen as load and verify stability.
steps.completion_criterion: VDD_frontend = 0.900V +/-5% under bias_gen load, no oscillation
steps.rollback: Delete test file. No production files modified.
steps.analog_specialist_notes: R=10MOhm = 5000 squares at 2kOhm/sq poly. Large but feasible. 100pF MIM cap is standard. Quiescent current = 90nA from divider.

steps.action: Design and test bias_gen startup: Add C_startup (5pF MIM cap) from VDD_frontend to bias_gen iref node. Test that bias_gen starts from zero IC with VDD ramp.
steps.completion_criterion: v(vbias) reaches 0.30V +/-10% within 1ms of VDD application, without any .ic statements
steps.verification: ngspice .tran with VDD_frontend ramp (0 to 0.9V in 10us), measure v(vbias) settling
steps.analog_specialist_notes: 5pF MIM is small. During 10us ramp: I_inject = 5pF * 90kV/s = 0.45nA, well above 150pA mirror current. After ramp, C passes no DC — zero steady-state disturbance.

steps.action: Build combined frontend-only test: VDD(1.8V) → R-divider → VDD_frontend → full frontend (asic_frontend subcircuit) with C_startup. Drive with real ECG PWL data for 3 beats. Verify frontend features match standalone results (no .ic except timer precharge which is natural).
steps.completion_criterion: Frontend features f1-f8 produce voltages in valid range (0.05V-0.85V) for beats 2+. Bias_gen starts without .ic.
steps.verification: Compare feature voltages at beat-valid times against standalone _integ_v7 results
steps.analog_specialist_notes: Timer/EWMA caps start at 0V — first beat is startup. Expect valid features from beat 2 onward. Frontend .ic for timers (v=0.9V precharge) can be dropped: timer naturally precharges via rpeak_pulse.

steps.action: Build full combined system netlist: frontend (from step 3) + B-source interface (affine mapping with feature reorder) + classifier crossbar. Feature mapping: F1→feat0, F2→feat3, F3→feat1, F4→feat4, F5→feat5, F6→feat2, F7→feat6, F8→feat7.
steps.completion_criterion: ngspice parses netlist without errors, .op converges
steps.verification: .op convergence check, verify all node voltages are physical (0-1.8V)
steps.analog_specialist_notes: B-sources read frontend feature voltages directly — no level shifting needed since B-sources are behavioral. Classifier sees affine-mapped row voltages in its 1.8V domain.

steps.action: Run transient simulation of full combined system with real ECG data for 3+ beats. Extract WTA outputs at feature-valid times. Verify classification matches standalone results.
steps.completion_criterion: WTA winner matches standalone prediction for >= 2/3 beats. Winner margin >= 5mV.
steps.verification: Compare WTA argmax against standalone test results from circuit_retrain_results.json
steps.analog_specialist_notes: May need to identify feature-valid time windows from delay timer outputs. WTA needs ~1ms settling after all features are valid.
